title: Authentication Failures
description: Authentication failures occur when an application incorrectly verifies identity or inadequately protects credentials, login flows, or authenticated sessions.
indicators: missing throttling for repeated login attempts
tokens or sessions remain valid after logout
prevention: Use established authentication and session-management components where possible.
Apply appropriate multi-factor authentication and throttling against automated login attempts.
Rotate session identifiers after authentication and invalidate sessions on logout and expiry.
source: OWASP Top 10:2025 A07 Authentication Failures (https://top10.owasp.org/2025/A07_2025-Authentication_Failures/); MITRE CWE-287 (https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/287.html)
